III §4): imithetho ithwele isinqumo esiyivumela futhi ayikwazi ukusidlela; imibiko igcina isigungu esiphethe nesishayamthetho zazi futhi ziba irekhodi lomphakathi. Konke okufayilwe lapha kuyirekhodi lomphakathi.

executive_home.selected_proportionally_t: Kukhethwa ngokulingana — indlela efanayo neyikomiti zesishayamthetho · Art. III §2 · irekhodi #q2. Amalungu anikezwe igunya ngamagunya esikhundla: wonke ahlala eyizilungu zezihlalo zeqhuba, futhi igunya lehhovisi lingel eqhuba.
executive_home.steps_in_in_rank_order_if: Izinyathelo zingena, ngokulandelana kwezikhundla, uma isihlalo siba nenguntu — ukubalwa kwabantu, hhayi ukuqashwa, okunquma ukulandelana (ukukhipha ngokulandelana · Art. III §3).
executive_home.term_one_clock_drives_bot: Isikhathi — iwashi elilodwa liqhuba ukukhetho zombili
executive_home.the_executive_is_delegate: Isigungu esiphethe sinikezwe igunya ngokuzvakala futhi sikhona njengesiqalo kusukela lapho indawo yegunya isungulwa. Ukuguqulwa sibe ihhovisi elikhethwa ngokuqondile yindlela eyodwa yokuba nesigungu esiphethe esizimele, futhi kunzima ngabomu: i-supermajority yeqhuba KANYE ne-supermajority yezindawo zegunya zabavoti kumele kuvumelane. Ikhadi lemodelu engenhla lihleza likhombisa isimo sangempela sehhovisi — hhayi into yokuzivocavoca.
executive_home.the_executive_is_the_gove: Isigungu esiphethe yingalo yokusebenza kahulumeni — sifeza imithetho, siqhuba iminyango, futhi siphendula esishayamthethweni esisidale. Isigungu esiphethe sonke siqala njengekomiti enikezwe igunya isishayamthetho. I-supermajority — kanye ne-supermajority yezindawo ezisakha, lapho zikhona — ingasiguqula sibe ihhovisi elikhethwa ngokuqondile, kungaba yikomiti yabantu abahlanu noma ngaphezulu abayizikhulu ezilinganayo, noma umuntu oyedwa onabashayeli abane. Izikhathi zesigungu esiphethe zihlala zilingana nesikhathi sesishayamthetho.
executive_home.the_office_is_in_a_transi: Ihhovisi likulesimo sokushintsha — bheka irekhodi lokuguqulwa ngezansi ukuze ubone ukuthi liphi kuphrosesi ye-supermajority yakabili.
executive_home.this_executive_was_create: Lesi sigungu esiphethe sakhiwe njengesiqalo lapho kusungulwa indawo yegunya. Alinabo amalungu kuze kube isishayamthetho sinikeze igunya ngesinqumo se-supermajority ( · WF-EXE-01). Kuze kube yilapho, ihhovisi likhona kuphela njengesikhala somthethosisekelo.
